name: Singapore

subjectOf.text: In Singapore there is no direct regulation of digital tokens under the Securities and Futures Act unless the currency is linked to an ownership or security interest in the issuer's assets or property.
subjectOf.abstract: There is no direct regulation under the SFA unless the currency is linked to an ownership or security interest in the issuers assets or property.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224

subjectOf.text: If a digital token security falls outside Monetary Authority of Singapore regulation, no duty of fair dealing applies to it.
subjectOf.abstract: If the security falls outside the MAS- regulations, there will be no duty of fair dealing.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Initial Coin Offerings The Top 25 Jurisdictions and Their Comparative Regulatory Responses (2018). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3117224
